title: Evaluate tui-tree-widget as the tree widget for the pebbles TUI
description:
EVALUATED 2026-09-19. Recommendation: ADOPT (minor caveats).
- Crate tui-tree-widget 0.24.1 (2026-08-09), repo github.com/EdJoPaTo/tui-rs-tree-widget (cloned at ~/repos/tui-tree-widget). Actively maintained, MIT, ~1080-line codebase with unit tests asserting exact rendered buffers.
- Targets ratatui 0.30. Pebbles has no ratatui dep yet, so no version conflict.
- API fit: TreeItem text is a full ratatui Text (status-color badges/epic styling are free). TreeState holds fold state + single selection + scroll + mouse keyed by identifier paths, so fold/selection survive rebuilding items from fresh data each frame. Enter-fold = toggle_selected().
- Demo verified: 2-level epic/pebble tree with colored badges, fold/unfold, scroll, headless on ratatui TestBackend — compiled and passed assertions first run.
- Gaps: single-select only (fine for the detail-pane model), no key-event glue (we wire keys), no independent badge column, scrollbar API experimental.
- Risks: single maintainer, minor-version churn with deprecations, ratatui-0.30-only. Pin exact version in Cargo.toml.
